title: System log kept 7 days, max 2 GB (diagnostics)
note: On by default (--skip journal-retention leaves it out). The system log (journald) is kept 7 days and may take up to 2 GB, leaving at least 2 GB of the storage free; on the author's printer it was limited to 4 days and 500 MB before (/etc/systemd/journald.conf).
